scope: Complete retained impact post-admission analysis only. Actual original admission, patch, fresh candidate admission/equality and input identity remain mandatory coordinator prerequisites.

findings.topic: Receipt keys and first semantic rejection
findings.conclusion: v1/v2 exact receipt and claim bit sets match the original; exact bool tags reject integer substitutes; status, domain, actual old/new canonical digests, original input identity and positive non-bool integer edits remain before inventories. All prefix failures map to original reason 1.

Old inventory then new inventory; missing old function refusal before change/interface analysis; compare complete canonical function plus name/params/returns/effects and return_loans default-null equivalence; exact ordered interface_changes precedes v2 policy or v1 prohibition. Original interface claims remain exact boolean observations.

Sorted new inventory is the common index after removal rejection. Old graph additionally rejects a callee not present in the old inventory; each graph deduplicates edges. Reverse BFS starts with all actual full-function changes, unions old/new edges, includes new functions and cycles, and publishes names/edges in the original sorted order.

SHA scratch [0,1120), digest copies [1200,1296), state [2048,2144), old inventory [4096,12288), new inventory [12288,20480), function rows [20480,53248), old bitmap [61440,192512), new bitmap [192512,323584), BFS queue [323584,331776) are disjoint relative to aligned arena end. Inventories and queue have at most 1024 elements, rows 32 bytes, bitmaps 128 bytes per caller. SCRATCH_BYTES=331776 covers the largest end exactly.

The preliminary measure is capacity only; actual strict decoder owns structure. The wire cap and measurement bound keep u64 layout arithmetic safe. render_fragment treats the selected subtree as its root; ordinary sorting affects only object order, and -0 normalizes to 0. The component replaces the bounded frontend append-byte helper with its own capacity-counting append and does not inherit the old 1MiB frontend emission cap.

Input/output/workspace shortages return NEED and precise required extents; payload is not complete on NEED. Reentry reparses the same private immutable transport and recomputes only this pure component, never repeats patch/admission peers. Final report measurement continues its cursor past output capacity, then returns size+76; after capacity is sufficient, report without sha256 is freshly emitted and hashed before final report emission.

before/after are independently hashed from actual decoded old/new canonical subtrees, rather than accepted receipt fields. Hash scratch is remapped below the stored digests. Final sha256 is actual SHA256 over canonical report excluding sha256; adding the canonical field costs exactly 76 bytes, is inserted at the correct sorted-key position, and the payload starts after the 128-byte event header.

This review does not inherit the proposed 104 cases or compiler success. Fresh original-limit generation/B3, complete report byte/digest differential, capacity/GROW/canaries and actual coordinator provenance remain to be measured. The source is a stateless private pure component, not an authenticator for arbitrary foreign Core/receipt inputs.
